name: Flat vector, no outline
why: Cheapest style to keep consistent — pure flat fills, no contour and no shading means there are very few degrees of freedom for a model to drift in. The cost is a weaker silhouette on a busy battlefield.

prompt_skeleton.style_medium: 2D game asset, flat vector illustration, solid colour shapes, no outline, no gradient, no texture
prompt_skeleton.lighting_mood: flat lighting, no shading, colour separation carries the form
constraints: asset fills the canvas with a {margin_pct}% margin

unit_design_rules: Without a contour, adjacent skeletal parts must differ in value or hue, otherwise the joint disappears into a single flat mass.
Silhouette does the whole job — check every asset in solid black before accepting it.
